messages:
ajay: Quick heads-up — RC build just failed E2E on payments. Failing test: payment_int_flow::timeout. Likely a flake but looks real. ETA to triage ~4h. Do we hold the announcement in #announcements or send a short slip notice?
release-bot: [ci] RC build #492 failed — 1 failing job (integration-payments). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/492 · issue created #infr-492

sophie: I can take a look at the payment test in ~15m. If it's a test-only flake we can hotfix and keep the announcement. If infra, we should slip. @tim can you pull logs for the GPU infra around the run?

tim: on it. grabbing logs now, will post any anomalies. quick grep shows a few 500s to the payments stub at 12:03 UTC, might be a downstream flakiness.

jess: For the announcement side — what's the minimal wording if we need a slip? Something like: "RC delayed ~4h for final verification; canary tomorrow still on track"? Want to avoid scaring customers.

meredith: Agreed keep wording calm. If it's under 6h we usually post a brief "shifted ETA" in #announcements and update release notes. If >6h escalate to a full delay note.

ajay: Proposal: hold headline announcement until canary passes. If triage shows test-only fix and PR lands in <3h, proceed. If not, post a 4h slip note. @sophie keep me posted.

sophie: quick repro locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_payment_flow.py::test_timeout_retry -k payment_int_flow -q` — reproduces consistently for me, seems to be a behavior change from the mock service. Pushing a patch to retry logic, PR incoming: #2345.

jess: ok — if PR #2345 merges and CI passes, do we still bump the version? I assume yes, we tag v1.11.0-rc and update CHANGELOG. The changelog needs a short blurb; I can draft.

ajay: yes bump to v1.11.0-rc (we planned minor). Hold off tagging until post-canary.

jess: changelog draft (putting here for quick copy):
```
- Fix retry logic for payments integration to prevent transient timeouts (PR #2345)
- Stability fixes for RC canary
```

release-bot: PR #2345 has been opened by sophie, CI started: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/498

tim: infra logs look clean except for the downstream 502 spike between 12:02-12:05 UTC. Not infra-host issue. Looks like the stub service had a brief outage.

meredith: Given that, plan stands: wait for PR CI. If green, merge -> run canary -> announce. If CI fails or new flakes appear, post a 4h slip in #announcements. @ajay you'll handle the announcement copy?

ajay: Yep — I'll prepare two short templates now (one slip, one go-ahead). Will wait for final CI. Template slip: "RC delayed by ~4 hours for extra verification after a flaky payment integration test. We're tracking and will update when canary starts. Sorry for the churn." Template go-ahead: "RC succeeded in verification; rolling canary starting now. Details..."

sophie: PR green on CI ✅ — merged and backported. Triggering canary now.

release-bot: Canary pipeline started: canary-rc-1777 · status: running · logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/canary/1777

ajay: Canary is running. I'll hold the announcement until canary passes. If canary stays healthy for 30m, I'll post "go-ahead" in #announcements with brief changelog and version tag. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks team — I'll prep the short CHANGELOG entry in the release notes page so ajay can paste.

meredith: Follow-up: add a one-line note in the release checklist about contacting the payments integration owners pre-RC to avoid last-minute surprises.

ajay: noted, will add to release checklist after this ship.

sophie: canary looks healthy so far, no new errors in the last 12m.

ajay: OK posting in 18m unless any regressions. I'll set status to "announce pending" in the release dashboard.

release-bot: Canary pipeline passed all smoke checks at 00:42 UTC — status: success.

ajay: Posting now in #announcements with changelog + tag v1.11.0-rc. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
